content.json:
# APM (Application Performance)

Monitors application golden signals — request rate, error rate, latency percentiles, dependency failures, and exceptions — reading from **APM_CL**.

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
APM_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where ItemType == "request"
| summarize
    RequestCount = count(),
    ReqPerMin    = count() / toint(_binSize / 1m)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, OperationName, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Request Rate (req/min) Over Time

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
APM_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where ItemType == "request"
| summarize
    TotalRequests  = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(IsSuccess == false)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, Environment
| extend ErrorRatePct = iff(TotalRequests > 0, round(FailedRequests * 100.0 / TotalRequests, 2), 0.0)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Error Rate % Over Time

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
APM_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where ItemType == "request"
| summarize
    P50Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    P99Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Latency P50 / P95 / P99 Over Time

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
APM_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where ItemType == "dependency"
| summarize
    TotalCalls  = count(),
    FailedCalls = countif(DependencySuccess == false),
    AvgDepMs    = avg(DependencyDurationMs)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, DependencyType, DependencyTarget, Environment
| extend DepFailRatePct = iff(TotalCalls > 0, round(FailedCalls * 100.0 / TotalCalls, 2), 0.0)
| order by DepFailRatePct desc
content.title: Dependency Failure Rate

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
APM_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where ItemType == "exception"
| summarize ExceptionCount = count()
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, ExceptionType, Environment
| order by ExceptionCount desc
content.title: Exceptions by Type Over Time
